name: levels/level-0-self-asserted
description: Level 0 (SELF_ASSERTED): an AgentCard declaring the agent-identity extension with identityLevel SELF_ASSERTED, a URN-format agentId, and an Ed25519 public key. No attestations are present and none are required — Level 0 makes no verifiable claim beyond well-formedness. A conforming verifier ACCEPTs the declaration shape while treating the identity as unverified (A2A-IDF Security Considerations: clients MUST NOT treat Level 0 agents as verified).

spec.section: §1 Agent Identity Verification Levels — Level 0 SELF_ASSERTED declaration shape
